definitions.explanation: An interrogative word used to ask which month of the year something occurs in or relates to. One of the most basic question words for dates in Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何月|なんがつ}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何月|なんがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{咲|さ}きます→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: In what month do the cherry blossoms bloom?

examples.japanese: {何月|なんがつ}⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ていない→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I haven't received word yet about what month and day it will arrive.

notes:
The interrogative form for months, combining ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what) with ⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧ (month). One of the most basic and frequently used question words for dates. Used when asking about specific months for events, schedules, seasons, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何月|なんがつ}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: what month is it?
- {何月|なんがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in what month
- {何月|なんがつ}⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧: what month and day
- {何月|なんがつ}⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧: around what month

RELATED DATE QUESTIONS:
- ⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧ — what day (of the month)
- ⟦{何曜日|なんようび}→何曜日：30346_nanyoubi⟧ — what day of the week
- ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧ — what year
- ⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧ — what time
